verdict.rationale: Tilled documents card-present support: a mock card-present provider that allows terminal creation and testing, plus closing batches via API so a store's transactions settle at end of shift. Nothing shows these in-person payments land in the same seller balances, payouts and reporting as online payments, and no tap-to-pay SDK is mentioned. Missing for 10: tap-to-pay/mobile SDK, explicit evidence of unified balances and reporting across in-person and online, production terminal hardware docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments

citations.quote: A mock card present provider, which allows for terminal creation and testing
By closing a batch via API, a store can ensure their transactions are settled at time of close or end of shift to account for easier reconciliation or tip adjustments.
